title: Comparison lemma: two locally admissible smooth approximations of G give asymptotically equal values X(η_n), via the homotopy formula and the affine estimate (supplied Step 1)
statement: The following notation is that of the frozen statement of the sibling smooth_homotopy, quoted here: Notation: for s ∈ ℝ and x ∈ ℝ^m, cons(s, x) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x)) ∈ ℝ^{m+1}; ι(v) := cons(0, v); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{m+1}; for y ∈ ℝ^{m+1}, t(y) := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ y 0 and tl(y) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ y)); cyl(A) := {y : t(y) ∈ [0,1], tl(y) ∈ A}. D_q(ℝ^p) := GeometricCurrentOn univ q, D^q(ℝ^p) := TestFormOn univ q, M = mass, spt = support, ∂ = boundary. For X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m) and Z ∈ D_{k+1}(ℝ^{m+1}), ProdChar(X, Z) means: for every η ∈ D^{k+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) and every φ : ℝ → D^k(ℝ^m) with φ(s)(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = η(cons(s, x))(e₀, ι(v_1), …, ι(v_k)) for all s ∈ [0,1], x ∈ ℝ^m, v ∈ (ℝ^m)^k (Fin.cons e₀ (ι ∘ v)), one has Z(η) = ∫_0^1 X(φ(s)) ds (interval integral). For g : ℝ^p → ℝ^q, ω ∈ D^j(ℝ^q), η ∈ D^j(ℝ^p) and A ⊆ ℝ^p, 'η is compatible with (g, ω) near A' means: there is an open N ⊇ A with η(x) = ω(g(x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ g x) for all x ∈ N. Here dω is exteriorDerivative ω. (E0) For all m, m′ ∈ ℕ, X ∈ D_0(ℝ^m) with M(X) < ∞, Z ∈ D_{0+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) with ProdChar(X, Z), and C^∞ G : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m′} with G⁻¹(K) ∩ cyl(spt X) compact for every compact K: for every ω ∈ D^0(ℝ^{m′}), all η₀, η₁ ∈ D^0(ℝ^m) such that η_i is compatible with (x ↦ G(cons(i, x)), ω) near spt X (i = 0, 1), and every η′ ∈ D^{0+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) compatible with (G, dω) near cyl(spt X): X(η₁) − X(η₀) = Z(η′). (E1) For all m, m′, j ∈ ℕ, X ∈ D_{j+1}(ℝ^m) with M(X) < ∞, Z ∈ D_{j+1+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) with ProdChar(X, Z), Z′ ∈ D_{j+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) with ProdChar(∂X, Z′), and G as in (E0): for every ω ∈ D^{j+1}(ℝ^{m′}), all η₀, η₁ ∈ D^{j+1}(ℝ^m) with η_i compatible with (x ↦ G(cons(i, x)), ω) near spt X, every η′ ∈ D^{j+1+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) compatible with (G, dω) near cyl(spt X) and every θ′ ∈ D^{j+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) compatible with (G, ω) near cyl(spt X): X(η₁) − X(η₀) = Z(η′) + Z′(θ′). (Aff) For all m, m′, k ∈ ℕ there is c ≥ 0 such that for all X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m), Z ∈ D_{k+1}(ℝ^{m+1}), C^∞ maps F₀, F₁ : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′}, open O ⊆ ℝ^m and s, L, B ∈ ℝ with 0 ≤ s, 0 ≤ L, 0 ≤ B, M(X) ≤ ofReal B, ProdChar(X, Z), spt X ⊆ O, dist(F₁(x), F₀(x)) ≤ s, ‖fderiv ℝ F₀ x‖ ≤ L and ‖fderiv ℝ F₁ x‖ ≤ L for x ∈ O, and F₀⁻¹(K) ∩ spt X compact for every compact K: for every ψ ∈ D^{k+1}(ℝ^{m′}), every C ∈ ℝ with covectorEuclideanNorm (ψ(y)) ≤ C for all y, and every η′ ∈ D^{k+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) compatible near cyl(spt X) with (G, ψ), where G(y) := F₀(tl(y)) + t(y)·(F₁(tl(y)) − F₀(tl(y))), one has |Z(η′)| ≤ c·s·L^k·B·C. Let (SH) denote the conjunction of (E0), (E1) and (Aff) above (verbatim the frozen statement of the sibling smooth_homotopy, Lean name dph_smooth_homotopy), and let (Prod) denote the proposition: for all m, k ∈ ℕ and every X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m) with M(X) < ∞ there is Z ∈ D_{k+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) with ProdChar(X, Z) (this is the existence assertion of part (I) of the frozen statement of the sibling interval_product, dph_interval_product, with its other assertions dropped). C^∞ means ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞), spt = support, and a map g is proper on F if g⁻¹(K) ∩ F is compact for every compact K. Claim: assume (Prod) and (SH). Then for all m, m′, k ∈ ℕ, every X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m) with M(X) < ∞ such that M(∂Y) < ∞ for every j ∈ ℕ and Y ∈ D_{j+1}(ℝ^m) with k = j + 1 and HEq Y X, every G : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} proper on spt X, all sequences (G_n), (G′_n) of C^∞ maps ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′}, all open O, O′ ⊆ ℝ^m with spt X ⊆ O and spt X ⊆ O′, and all L, L′ ∈ ℝ such that eventually ‖fderiv ℝ G_n x‖ ≤ L for all x ∈ O, eventually ‖fderiv ℝ G′_n x‖ ≤ L′ for all x ∈ O′, G_n → G uniformly on O and G′_n → G uniformly on O′, and for every ω ∈ D^k(ℝ^{m′}) and all sequences (η_n), (η′_n) in D^k(ℝ^m) such that eventually η_n is compatible with (G_n, ω) near spt X and eventually η′_n is compatible with (G′_n, ω) near spt X: X(η′_n) − X(η_n) → 0 as n → ∞.
